title: fix(alertmanager): report status and body on non-2xx responses

files.patch:
@@ -3,6 +3,7 @@ package checks
 import (
 	"encoding/json"
 	"fmt"
+	"io"
 	"net/url"
 	"strings"
 
@@ -14,6 +15,9 @@ import (
 	alertmanagerAlert "github.com/prometheus/alertmanager/api/v2/client/alert"
 )
 
+// maxErrorBodyBytes caps how much of a non-2xx response body is read into the error message.
+const maxErrorBodyBytes = 4096
+
 type AlertManagerChecker struct{}
 
 func (c *AlertManagerChecker) Type() string {
@@ -66,7 +70,9 @@ func (c *AlertManagerChecker) Check(ctx *context.Context, extConfig external.Che
 		return results
 	}
 	if !resp.IsOK() {
-		results.ErrorMessage(fmt.Errorf("received non 2xx from alertmanager: %v", err))
+		defer resp.Body.Close()
+		body, _ := io.ReadAll(io.LimitReader(resp.Body, maxErrorBodyBytes))
+		results.ErrorMessage(fmt.Errorf("received non 2xx from alertmanager: %s: %s", resp.Status, body))
 		return results
 	}
 	respStr, err := resp.AsString()
